One Expert, Machine-Scale Cognition

A field guide to expanding checked search without expanding false confidence

Tier BEdition 2.1.0101 pp.CC-BY-4.0

An evidence-bounded field guide for experts using language models to expand search, computation and comparison while controlling review debt, weak verification and unsafe action. Edition 2 derives every operating rule from Transformer computation and the mathematics of selection under uncertainty.
